cohort: 1048 preschool children aged 3-6 years in Tanta City, Gharbia Governorate
finding: The prevalence of ADHD among preschoolers was 10.5%, with significant maternal and child risk factors identified.
mod_finding: Cesarean section delivery was found to be statistically significantly associated with ADHD in preschoolers (66.4% positive vs. 53.9% negative).
